scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
